---
title: "Sources"
jupyter: coi-docs
---

Every section below is generated at *build* time from the ingest module's
own docstring (`ast.get_docstring`) — the licence quote, version axis,
geography vintage, and deliberate omissions are written once, in the code
that does the ingest, and reproduced here rather than retyped. Nothing on
this page is hand-copied licence text.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import ast
import re
from pathlib import Path

from canceronice import schemas

# Module -> its `canceronice` CLI subcommand (src/canceronice/__main__.py).
# Hardcoded rather than parsed out of __main__.py's argparse calls: it's a
# short, stable list, and regexing argparse construction for this would be
# more code than the mapping itself.
CLI_SUBCOMMAND = {
    "census_gazetteer": "gazetteer",
    "places": "places",
    "ers_rucc": "rucc",
    "geography_alias": "geo-alias",
    "cancer_site": "cancer-site",
    "cdc_svi": "svi",
    "ers_ruca": "ruca",
    "ers_food_access": "food-access",
    "hrsa_ahrf": "ahrf",
    "hrsa_sites": "hrsa-sites",
    "scp": "scp",
    "fda_mqsa": "mqsa",
    "epa_sdwis": "sdwis",
    "bls_laus": "laus",
}

SRC_DIR = Path("../../src/canceronice")
KNOWN_TABLES = set(schemas.TABLES)
TABLE_RE = re.compile(r'"([a-z_]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)"')

def markdownify(docstring):
    """Docstrings already read as Markdown prose; only bump heading levels
    so a module's own '##'/'###' nest under this page's '##' per-source
    heading instead of colliding with it."""
    def bump(m):
        return "#" * (len(m.group(1)) + 2) + m.group(2)
    return re.sub(r"^(#{1,4})( .*)$", bump, docstring, flags=re.MULTILINE)

for module_name in sorted(CLI_SUBCOMMAND):
    path = SRC_DIR / f"{module_name}.py"
    source = path.read_text()
    doc = ast.get_docstring(ast.parse(source))
    tables_written = [t for t in dict.fromkeys(TABLE_RE.findall(source)) if t in KNOWN_TABLES]

    title = module_name.replace("_", " ")
    print(f"## {title} {{#src-{module_name}}}\n")
    print(f"`uv run canceronice {CLI_SUBCOMMAND[module_name]}` "
          f"([`src/canceronice/{module_name}.py`]"
          f"(https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/blob/main/src/canceronice/{module_name}.py))\n")
    if tables_written:
        table_links = ", ".join(f"[`{t}`](/dictionary/index.qmd)" for t in tables_written)
        print(f"**Tables written:** {table_links}\n")
    print(markdownify(doc))
    print("\n---\n")
```
